==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. (My name is Jet. Here is a general description of what I look like "Man with dark-brown skin, full dark-brown beard, long dark-brown dreadlocks spilling from beneath a black hoodie over a “Dream Anime” graphic tee, black athletic pants with a white stripe, white sneakers, black cross-body belt bag, warm brown eyes.")
This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a  metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.)
I continued right where my last dream left off in the VR City Biome of the Super Cathedral alongside Savannah (A pale skinned cyborg woman with long black hair, bangs that covered her forehead, with glowing red eyes, and wearing a futuristic silver bodysuit) and her father Tecton (Tecton is a green skinned, humanoid, muscular, cat ogre, barbarian who dresses in a brown loin cloth and a silver baldric.).
Inside our sewer hideaway that we took from the hazmat cult, we discussed the incredible number of strategic options at my disposal.
The Rainbow Sword is great for offense, defense, and healing.
The Energy Tether, my golden energy rope, is great for boosting allies, overloading opponents, and disarming opponents.
Chipper, my miniature floating silver crab drone, is great for back up and its ability to grow with additional energy makes it a powerhouse.
But our conversation was being spied on by the leader of the hazmat cult.
He was a man with spiky navy blue slicked back hair, large round black glasses, blue eyes, and gray pale skin.
He wore a brown business suit with a brown fur cape.
He popped out of the shadows using the information he overheard and summoned a brown box of fur over one of my arms.
He was quick as he had already taken the baton we had used to trick the Sewage Dragon into defending us.
The fur bomb on my arm was ticking down, and it seemed like there was nothing I could do about it.
The Rainbow Sword's defensive shield couldn't stop the bomb, because the bomb would simply end up inside the shield with me.
Tampering with a bomb is risky, especially one that seems like a living creature, leaving Savannah and Tecton stumped on how to help.
I decided to try something unexpected.
I used energy tether to connect the fur bomb and the cult leader.
When the bomb went off, I had the tether transmit all of the explosive energy to the cult leader.
The cult leader bursts into a shower of pixels, granting all of us experience points as the fur creature on my arm dissipated.
This dream was thrilling and intellectually stimulating, as it pushed me to have to think of a clever new strategy.
